versions.changelog:
- Increased API rate limits from 10/10 to 20/20 for sustained and burst throughput.
- Market cap calculation updated: use `price.price × circulating_supply` (`price` is now a nested object).
- Removed the redundant file: skill-card.md.
- Minor wording changes for clarity in documentation.

gmgn-token v1.2.8

- Added Ethereum ("eth") support for all commands and arguments.
- Updated argument hints and documentation to include Ethereum.
- Expanded wallet tag filters for holders/traders commands.
- No code or implementation changes detected; documentation update only.

gmgn-token 1.2.7

- Updated and clarified skill description for wider audience and better search relevance.
- Emphasized use cases: supports both crypto and meme token research on Solana, BSC, and Base.
- Shortened and streamlined several documentation sections to improve clarity.
- No functional or command changes; documentation and description update only.

gmgn-token 1.2.6

- Updated the skill description to clarify use cases, highlighting research/due diligence for any token by address or name.
- Description now better communicates support for token price, safety, top holders/traders, and market data across Solana, BSC, and Base.
- Made minor language improvements for clarity and user guidance.
- No functional or CLI/API changes; documentation update only.

- Expanded skill description to clearly list all supported token insights and use cases.
- Enhanced sub-command descriptions to highlight real-time price, market cap, social links, and Smart Money features.
- Clarified that market cap is calculated as price × circulating supply.
- Updated documentation to be more beginner-friendly and explicit about parameter requirements.
- No code changes or command behavior modifications; documentation improvement only.

- Added a detailed rate limit section, including per-route weights, expected cooldown/retry behavior, and user messaging for 429 errors.
- Simplified skill description to emphasize supported chains and main token queries.
- Minor metadata clean-up and standardization for CLI help reference.
- All core command usage and parameter documentation remains unchanged.

Initial release. On-chain token intelligence for Solana, BNB Chain, and Base Chain — security audit, rug pull risk, liquidity pool data, top holder distribution, and smart money / KOL trader activity via GMGN.
